description: This file defines the KubernetesHostingOptions class, which provides configuration options for hosting Orleans silos in a Kubernetes environment. It includes constants for environment variable names, properties for configuration settings such as MaxAgents and MaxKubernetesApiRetryAttempts, and internal properties for namespace, pod name, and pod IP.

classes.name: KubernetesHostingOptions
classes.description: A class encapsulating configuration options for hosting Orleans silos within Kubernetes, including environment variable names, client configuration, and operational parameters.
